items.summary: Fix the Internet Identity login/logout UX so users can reliably log in and log out without getting stuck in an inconsistent state (e.g., repeated clicks, "User is already authenticated" loop, requiring a hard refresh), without changing the app’s visual design.

Ensure the Acquisition Portal presale and airdrop countdown timers unlock at the correct UTC times for Q1 2027 (presale) and Q1 2029 (airdrop), and that the backend exposes correct remaining time values in nanoseconds.

Ensure both Acquisition Portal forms (Presale Registration and Airdrop Registration) redirect to WhatsApp for the configured direct number (+92 329 4238997) when unlocked, and that pending submissions saved before unlock automatically redirect once the countdown reaches zero, without changing the visual design.

Complete any missing wiring required so authentication-gated pages that depend on backend permissions (via AccessControl) work consistently after login, including ensuring the actor initialization/access-control initialization path does not intermittently leave the app in an unauthenticated/unauthorized state after a successful Internet Identity login.
